title: CSS Animations with @keyframes 🎬
description: Create complex, multi-step animations using the `@keyframes` rule and animation properties.

slides.title: Transitions vs Animations 🆚
slides.content:
# Transitions React, Animations Act

- **Transitions** need a trigger (hover, class change) and go from state A to B.
- **Animations** can run automatically, loop infinitely, play in reverse, and have multiple keyframes.

Animations give you fine‑grained control over every stage of motion.

slides.title: Animation Sub‑Properties 🎛️
slides.content:
# Fine‑Tune Every Aspect

- `animation-name` – the name of the `@keyframes`.
- `animation-duration` – how long one cycle takes.
- `animation-timing-function` – easing curve (can be set per keyframe!).
- `animation-delay` – wait before starting.
- `animation-iteration-count` – number of times (`infinite` for forever).
- `animation-direction` – `normal`, `reverse`, `alternate`, `alternate-reverse`.
- `animation-fill-mode` – what styles apply before/after the animation.
- `animation-play-state` – `running` or `paused` (great for pausing on hover).

slides.title: Loading Spinner Animation

quizData.question: What does `animation: bounce 1s ease-in-out 3 alternate;` do?

options.text: Plays bounce 3 times, reversing direction each time

quizData.explanation: `3` is iteration count, `alternate` makes it play forward then backward each iteration.
